reviews.title: lovely flight
reviews.text: It is too bad that Sky Work stops operating.!!! All the small companies are absorbed by huge ones. I just discovered it and had a very pleasant convenient flight from Bern to London city last month. Convenient because leaving from Belp, a small airport no hektic, and arriving in London. A small airplane makes you feel like being in a private jet. Schedule was on time, nice comfortable seats, smily and caring attendants. I have been planning to fly with them again, but it is sad to learn they are no longer operating. What i don't like is the customs at Belp airport. I wonder if it is related with the size of the airport. I have been traveling all over the world for more than 40 years, and understand they are doing their job. But for the first time i feel annoyed by such unpleasant attitude of non smiling and rude.
reviews.author: cobelolem

reviews.title: Smooth Sailing
reviews.text: From ordering my ticket. Checking in at the airport in Amsterdam and landing in Berne Switzerland everything went smoothly and efficiently. The crew and flight attendant were friendly and attentive. I was very happy with my experience.
reviews.author: deegalNYC

reviews.title: Lost luggage
reviews.text: I flew from Amsterdam to Bern after a connecting flight from Manchester with luggage checked in all the way through from Manchester to Bern. The last time I saw my suitcase was on Monday 30th July. It didn't arrive in Bern and nobody can give me any information. It is now Thursday 2nd August and I haven't heard anything. I return home tomorrow and it has ruined my holiday not having my things with me. The airline said that I can spend 80 Swiss francs a day on essentials but this is Switzerland and 80 francs doesn't go far! Not when it was Swiss National Day yesterday and I had packed a special outfit and goodies to contribute to my friends' party. I have flown this route to Bern a few times and this is why I am so disappointed with the lack of communication. I will have to seriously consider using a different carrier next time.
reviews.author: pauline777

reviews.title: Great connection BRN-MUC
reviews.text: Online reservation system makes you feel back in 00’s. Fare quite pricey. Check-in super fast at Bern-Belpmoos airport, friendly staff, great flying experience in the SAAB 2000, surprisingly spacious seating, nice view of the old town of Bern, in-flight service good and speedy, flight on time.
reviews.author: vesalian

reviews.title: easy and reliable
reviews.text: Flying from Berne to London with SkyWork is always a great pleasure. Check in is fast, and uncomplicated. The crew couldn't be nicer, all in all a very pleasant experience! Why would I fly from Zurich with all the hustle and bustle if I can fly from Berne with SkyWork!!
reviews.author: Jane S

reviews.title: Maintenance ...
reviews.text: After Checking we were asked to wait because the aircraft security system indicated a problem that needed to be resolved. The luggage was transferred to another plane. Sometime after we were told that the signal in the original aircraft had disappeared, so the luggage was taken over again. We left 3 hours late ... One would expect that the maintenance people would check out things the evening before. On the way back even worse - the plane that was supposed to get us in Palma couldn’t be used, so they had to send the staff to Basel to get another one ... that left us with another delay of 4 hours. Unacceptable !
reviews.author: ChrKueng

reviews.title: Perfect flight all round
reviews.text: Very smooth flight, excellent service. Has nearly feel of private plane Very reasonable price if booked in advance
reviews.author: Charlotte F

reviews.title: Fly to Bern. It's the Best. Period.
reviews.text: As a frequent flyer with Skywork I cannot confirm any of the bad customer service reviews or whatever. I am a regular on this airline. And it's fun to fly, friendly staff, and if something goes wrong you are taken care of. 100% recommended. Also the airport in Bern is a gem, not to mention the scenery if you get a south departure on a nice day. It's really tops. Potentials: - Still no loyalty program. - No profile for easy rebooking on the website. - Website anyhow not high end. - There is room for improvement. No offer for instance to buy 10 tickets between 2 cities for frequent travelers, that would be cool. - please move back to Terminal D in TXL. C is a real hassle... Keep going with your excellent work. I consider you whenever possible. Thanks @ Team Skywork
reviews.author: BrunoP71

reviews.title: Bern Belp - London City
reviews.text: This is the best flying experience I have had and certainly the best way to travel between Bern and London. Check-in could not be faster and more friendly. It may not be luxurious but if you're mostly travelling cheap airlines, then this is more than an upgrade. Plus, both airports are small and hence very accessible and fast to go through. And when the weather is good, flying over Bern and central London is simply spectacular
reviews.author: jalogo

reviews.title: Everything would be top if they would talk and inform properly
reviews.text: They made us check-in at 11h30 (flight was due at 12h00) and once we were in the waiting-room, we get told that we cannot fly and that more news will follow at 15h30. No more information, nothing on what is happening just that we must wait. At 15h30 we get told that we must wait longer, but still no reason why... more news will follow at 16h00, anyway to cut a long story short, we finally flew at 17h15. I find this unfriendly and a complete customer killer. Problems do happen but by treating customers like mushrooms, they don't find sympathy, and it happenend twice during February and March. So pity because the airline with its normal services is great.
reviews.author: WatchFox

reviews.title: Bern Airport
reviews.text: A delightful small airport and a small plane which left and arrived on time. There are limited shopping facilities at Bern but you don't need to arrive until about 30 mins before departure
reviews.author: stromaneilston

reviews.title: I liked it!
reviews.text: To be honest, I was scared!!!! But I like adventures so I decided to try Skywork Airlines. And it became a very nice flight, the flight attendant was very kind, the coffee was delicious and we all arrived punctually. You just come down and relax in this little plane, it was the first time I experienced after the arrival, that the people were not jumping up and trying to be the first to get out...
reviews.author: Dani F

reviews.title: Bus instead of Plane
reviews.text: Booked a flight from Bern to Munich as I had to be there early in the morning. Due to weather conditions (fog) the plane couldn’t land in Bern the day before. When I arrived at the airport they told me that we would have to go by bus to Basel which is 90-120min away and from there we can take the plane. I don’t blame SkyWork for the weather conditions that made it apparently impossible for their planes to land at Bern airport but there was definitely a lack of communication. If the plane didn’t land the day before they could have at least informed me that there will be a delay. I could have checked other options like rental car or even the train to be on time in Munich.
reviews.author: maxican

reviews.title: Super Airline
reviews.text: In the last few months i flew several times with SkyWork Airlines. I can only recommend this airline. I was always very happy with the service on board. And Bern Airport is class, arriving just 30 min before takeoff is enough time for the check in etc., absolutely stress free travelling!
reviews.author: Chris S

reviews.title: My flight from London City Airport to Bern was cancelled without notice and all I received was a food voucher.
reviews.text: When my flight was cancelled at the last moment all I got was a food voucher and rerouting. I was over 8 hours late in arriving at my destination airport. It was only later than I discovered I was entitled to free calls and compensation. The staff at the check-in desk only offered the food vouchers when passengers insisted. Then the flight we were offered to Berne was also delayed. As I was unable to walk without aid, I was trapped at London City Airport for most of the day and did not arrive at my holiday accommodation until 1.30 am the next day. Luckily it was self-catering and not a hostel or access might have proven difficult. As it was, I missed out on a day's holiday.
reviews.author: post4pete

reviews.title: Flight with a very entertaining flight attendent
reviews.text: We had a very calm and pleasant flight with SkyWorks (as usual...). This time, our flight attendent made the difference. Mr. Grueniger did a superb job with servicing and entertaing us as real guests. Even the security instruction were that good with his attitude, that the whole plane was paying attention (first time ever I saw that ;-)... thx, this flight was a really nice experience.
reviews.author: CrazyPif

reviews.title: Great little airline
reviews.text: Both flight were on time. Service was friendly and they offer coffee and pie for lunch. Airport was small but there was a bus/train connection to the town.
reviews.author: George P

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Don't book! This airline is unprofessional and about to fail. One chance out of two that you will not arrive at destiny and if you have bad luck you're ticket will not even be valid anymore... One thing: they don't care.
reviews.author: tripit1478

reviews.title: A great experience
reviews.text: It was the first time I travelled with SkyWork airlines last weekend and I must admit I was worried as I had never heard the company before. It turned out to be an amazing experience that is not a very common case these days. Both my outbound and return flights took off on time. There was little or no queue or delay on boarding as the number of passengers is quite limited on such small planes. The staff was very polite and helpful and I didn't feel the stress that you normally get on modern flights, especially when you travel between popular destinations such as London and during the busy season of August. To anyone who is unsure about SkyWork, as I was last week, I'd just advise you to give it a go..
reviews.author: Rania K

reviews.title: Awful experience!
reviews.text: I booked a flight for the 7th July which was cancelled on short notice. We were assured to be booked on the early morning flight the following morning and had to stay in hotel over night. Once back at the airport early morning 6 a.m. the 8th, this flight was cancelled too. In both cases without any real explanation why. Customer service seems to be non existing- some passengers had to pay for their own flight with another airline some others were told to take the evening flight The poor people are probably still sitting there now! Customer service was really funny when I phoned to get refund.....
reviews.author: Carlo1674

reviews.title: Cancelled my flight and delays in paying refund
reviews.text: Booked flights from London city to Basel a couple of times On 27th june try cancelled our morning flight on the 11th July and expect me to wait 5-7 weeks for a refund . They have just sent me an email asking me to be patient when I queried why the money hadn't been returned to my card Can I ask why I should be patient, you took the money immediately from my card, you have inconvenienced us by then cancelling the flight.
reviews.author: Issy33

reviews.title: A Fantastic Little Airline That Could Show Others A Thing Or Two
reviews.text: This was my first flight with Skywork Airlines, and as I was travelling to Bern found that it was the only airline offering a nonstop flight to the Swiss capital from anywhere in the UK. My flight was aboard a Dornier 328, with just 31 seats. You get the feeling you are aboard a private aircraft, as the passenger numbers are obviously far less than larger aircraft. We were warmly greeted on boarding by the member of cabin crew, and as I had seat 3A I was swiftly in my seat and my hand luggage stored in the overhead luggage area. Although we had a slight delay due to refuelling, we eventually left around twenty minutes late. Our takeoff from London City Airport was quite eventful as the pilot's need to apply full power due to the short runway length. Our takeoff was somewhat akin to being kicked up the rear with a boot. The flight was smooth enough, and aside from one empty seat we had a full passenger load. Service was very good and the cabin crew member extremely attentive. Everyone is offered a choice of sweet or savory snack and a choice of tea, coffee, water or soft drinks. Alcoholic beverages can be purchased. A luggage allowance of 23kg is offered in all tickets, and that to me is quite acceptable. Our arrival in to Bern offered a wonderful view of the Alps and valleys. Some spectacular scenery was had. Upon landing we were off the plane, through passport control and bags received in under ten minutes, meaning we got straight on to the airport bus heading for Belp Railway Station, and on to the main railway station in Bern. Skywork Airlines is a great little airline that could show the bigger carriers a thing or two. Flying to two superb airports, which offer a good service, really helps and I will definitely use them again, as they also fly to Basel. Our return flight to London City was aboard one of the carrier's larger, Saab 2000 aircraft, which was equally good. Flying time to/from Bern is in the region of ninety to one hundred minutes. I would encourage everyone to try this carrier if either Bern or Basel are your destinations.
reviews.author: Paul Smith

reviews.title: Recommended to give it a try
reviews.text: I had a very nice experience flying with Skywords: From buying until boarding, I had no problems. The flight craft departed and arrived on time - as a Swiss-operated company something the passengers would expect, I assume. They served a little snack on board which was nice but not excellent (croissant was either one of these industry-ones or not very fresh anymore). Skyworks is definitely an option I will consider for my future flights (as an alternative to Basel).
reviews.author: Pinga123

reviews.title: An excellent airline with a more personal service
reviews.text: I fly Skywork frequently from London City Airport to Berne and Basel. A few things stand out. First, the cabin crew are the best I have experienced by some distance - being remembered and welcomed back on board is surprisingly lovely. Secondly, although you wouldn't mistake the Saab 2000s or Dornier 328s for private jets, being in a smaller aircraft is far more charming than the larger fleets; less people equates to less stress. Third, the airports of London City and Berne are great - compact but with everything you need. True, the flight schedule is not comprehensive, but if more people choose Skywork over the flag carriers I am sure they will expand their network and frequency. I encourage you to give them a try.
reviews.author: MrFredBrown

reviews.title: Competition would make this airline provide better service
reviews.text: Fly with Skywork regularly but less and less due to missing service. Realise it is a small airline but they way they deal with passengers when facing delays or cancellations or their offerings to group travel is awful. Unfortunately, they face no competition from Bern which would force them to be better but alternatives at other airports such as Basel and Zurich do offer alternatives which are often both better and cheaper. Provide better service up, serve better coffee, treat "loyal" customers better, connect better with businesses in Bern....LOTS of room for improvement.
reviews.author: Krisworld5

reviews.title: Change the Future of Air Travel Fly SkyWork Airline
reviews.text: Small, very efficient, on time, friendly, speedy, easy, comfortable, affordable. Please can we go back to the old days. It is a pleasure flying this way and SkyWorks partnership with Belp, Berne Airport is obviously working brilliantly. Well done ! Thank you !
reviews.author: dellingermiguel

reviews.title: A Pleasure & what a great idea
reviews.text: What a great little Airline. Everything felt easy, flowing, direct, no nonsense, quick. Crew easy, polite, helpful. Boarding simple. The whole trip a pleasure. Thank you ! Please, please do your best to lower your prices and add Lisbon to your flight plans ! I want to fly more with you :)
reviews.author: dellingermiguel

reviews.title: Small, Swiss, Effective
reviews.text: Skywork offers exactly the kind of service that became unusual in the big airline business, where everyone wants to operate long-distance through hubs. Skywork uses Bern airport, which is one of the nicest I have ever used. They offer regular direct services to a number of European destinations. Great to fly in or out Switzerland. The planes are very small so you get a real feeling of flying.
reviews.author: EuropeanDiversity
